tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: Ask a human to approve a change to the factory. replace_bearing stops the machine about 45 ticks (135 if it has broken down); reset_setting stops it 10 ticks and puts its speed back to standard; replace_servo_drive stops it 60 ticks and fits a new axis servo drive; repair_hydraulics (machines with hydraulics only) stops it 40 ticks and replaces its seals. Nothing happens until a human decides; check with get_proposals. The reason says why, and what you expect to see afterwards.

tools.name: recall_memories
tools.invoked_by: research_agent policy when the run offers it; the manual step also calls search_manual once before planning
tools.description: Search lessons kept from earlier investigations by words, e.g. the symptom. An answer is a past investigation's belief, not a look at the factory now: it can suggest where to look, never prove anything. At most 3 searches per investigation; the same search twice is refused. If an answer does not help, search again with different words, or carry on without memory.
tools.boundary: source 'memory'; the loop labels provenance origin='memory' so verification and the memory gate discount it
tools.simulator_access: none; answers come from the memory store or the manual, stamped with the factory tick only

tools.name: search_manual
tools.invoked_by: research_agent policy when the run offers it; the manual step also calls search_manual once before planning
tools.description: Search the maintenance manual for this machine model (SIM-CNC-001) by words, e.g. a symptom or a suspected cause. Returns numbered sections (cite them as §2.7): what a symptom can mean, possible causes, and the checks that tell them apart. The manual describes the machine type, not what is happening now: confirm what it suggests with the factory's own data. At most 3 searches per investigation; the same search twice is refused.
tools.output_contract: manual section rows (section, title, text, document)
tools.boundary: source 'manual'; the loop labels provenance origin='manual' so verification and the memory gate discount it
tools.simulator_access: none; answers come from the memory store or the manual, stamped with the factory tick only
tools.limits: at most 3 searches, repeats refused (providers/manual.py); sections checked for leaks (manual/sections.py)
